courses.title: 光纖陣列主動對準
courses.summary: 以多軸光纖陣列搜尋、功率正規化與固定後漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Multiaxis fiber-array search, normalized power and post-attach drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。
workedExample.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch.
workedExample.assumptions: 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.title: 定義光功率參考面：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define optical power reference planes: model and design
steps.objective: 建立定義光功率參考面的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define optical power reference planes.
steps.instruction: 先標出「定義光功率參考面」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for define optical power reference planes. Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。
steps.observationEn: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「輸出變亮一定表示位置更準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Higher output always means better position" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交定義光功率參考面的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for define optical power reference planes: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.textEn: Reflections, sidelobes and scattering create local maxima; one hill climb need not find the global optimum.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 由三個不同起點搜尋，核對峰位置及頻譜是否一致。 不可推成：任何零梯度點都是最佳耦合
knowledge.textEn: Search from three starting points and compare peak positions and spectra. Do not infer: Every zero-gradient point is optimum coupling

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
knowledge.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch. Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.

steps.objective: 建立量測纖距與傾斜的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for measure pitch and roll mismatch.
steps.instruction: 先標出「量測纖距與傾斜」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。旋轉能修正陣列斜率，不能消除纖距與局部芯偏心造成的非線性殘差。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for measure pitch and roll mismatch. Roll corrects array slope but not pitch or local core eccentricity residuals. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 畫通道編號對最佳位置，分離共同偏移、斜率和局部殘差。
steps.observationEn: Plot optimum position by channel and separate offset, slope and local residuals.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「旋轉陣列可消除任何纖芯偏差」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Rotating an array removes every core error" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交量測纖距與傾斜的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：畫通道編號對最佳位置，分離共同偏移、斜率和局部殘差。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for measure pitch and roll mismatch: Plot optimum position by channel and separate offset, slope and local residuals. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 畫通道編號對最佳位置，分離共同偏移、斜率和局部殘差。 不可推成：旋轉陣列可消除任何纖芯偏差
knowledge.textEn: Plot optimum position by channel and separate offset, slope and local residuals. Do not infer: Rotating an array removes every core error

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
knowledge.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch. Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.

knowledge.text: 假設兩個相同 Gaussian 模態的強度 1/e² 半徑 w=2 μm，橫向偏移 d=1 μm，η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788，單一偏移損耗 1.086 dB。若 d 降到 0.5 μm，損耗為 0.271 dB；均未含角度、端面反射及模態尺寸差。 功率最大化不是幾何位置校準；雷射漂移、偏振、探測器飽和和多通道權重都可能改變搜尋結果。
knowledge.textEn: For identical Gaussian modes with 1/e² intensity radius w=2 μm and lateral offset d=1 μm, η=exp[−(d/w)²]=0.7788 and offset loss is 1.086 dB. Reducing d to 0.5 μm gives 0.271 dB, excluding angle, facet reflection and size mismatch. Power maximization is not geometric calibration; laser drift, polarization, detector saturation and channel weighting can alter the search.

steps.instruction: 先標出「設計止擋與間隙」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。軸向止擋控制端面距離，但熱膨脹或過大預壓可能造成端面接觸損傷。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for design stops and gaps. Axial stops control gaps, but expansion or excessive preload can damage contacting facets. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 畫最小和最大間隙角點並確認沒有機械干涉。
steps.observationEn: Draw minimum/maximum gap corners and check mechanical interference.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「間隙越小永遠越安全且低損耗」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "A smaller gap is always safer and lower loss" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交設計止擋與間隙的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：畫最小和最大間隙角點並確認沒有機械干涉。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for design stops and gaps: Draw minimum/maximum gap corners and check mechanical interference. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 軸向止擋控制端面距離，但熱膨脹或過大預壓可能造成端面接觸損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Axial stops control gaps, but expansion or excessive preload can damage contacting facets.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 畫最小和最大間隙角點並確認沒有機械干涉。 不可推成：間隙越小永遠越安全且低損耗
knowledge.textEn: Draw minimum/maximum gap corners and check mechanical interference. Do not infer: A smaller gap is always safer and lower loss

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設三個獨立零均值位置標準差為 0.3、0.4、0.2 μm，合成 σ=√(0.3²+0.4²+0.2²)=0.539 μm；若另有 0.8 μm 系統偏差，它必須獨立保留，不能放進 RSS 後當作可抵消誤差。 機械公差模型需有同一座標與相關性假設；V 溝可定位包層，不會自動量到纖芯和光學模態中心。
knowledge.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term. Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.

knowledge.textEn: Assume independent zero-mean position standard deviations 0.3, 0.4 and 0.2 μm: combined σ=0.539 μm. A separate 0.8 μm systematic bias must remain explicit; it is not a canceling random RSS term. Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.

optionsEn: Compare cross-lot pass fractions and rework causes, marking unmeasured tolerances.
Passive alignment always yields better than active alignment
A diced edge is an exact optical-center datum

quiz.explanationEn: Compare cross-lot pass fractions and rework causes, marking unmeasured tolerances. Mechanical tolerances need common coordinates and covariance assumptions; a V-groove locates cladding, not automatically the core or optical-mode center.

courses.title: 光纖黏著固定與熱漂移
courses.titleEn: Fiber adhesive attachment and thermal drift
courses.summary: 以光纖膠固化收縮、熱失配與長期黏彈漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Fiber-adhesive cure shrinkage, thermal mismatch and viscoelastic drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。
workedExample.textEn: For free paths with Δα=15 ppm/K, L=4 mm and ΔT=60 K, mismatch is 3.6 μm. If entirely projected laterally onto matched Gaussian modes with w=3 μm, loss is 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB. Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance.
workedExample.assumptions: 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Volumetric shrinkage is not linear shrinkage; small isotropic free linear shrinkage is about one third of volume shrinkage, but constrained bond lines require a mechanical model.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.title: 選擇黏著位置：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Choose adhesive placement: model and design
steps.objective: 建立選擇黏著位置的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for choose adhesive placement.
steps.instruction: 先標出「選擇黏著位置」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。光路內膠需評估吸收與折射率，機械固定膠則仍會透過應力影響光路。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for choose adhesive placement. In-path adhesive needs absorption/index evaluation; out-of-path adhesive still affects optics through stress. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。
steps.observationEn: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「膠不在光路內就完全不影響光學」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Out-of-path adhesive cannot affect optical behavior" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交選擇黏著位置的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for choose adhesive placement: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Independent verification of polarization splitting, rotation and modal leakage, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想輸入 1 mW，目標端口功率 0.800 mW、洩漏端口 0.008 mW，端口消光比 10log10(0.800/0.008)=20 dB；兩端口總傳輸 0.808 對應 0.926 dB 損耗。消光比和總傳輸是不同量，尚未單獨量出偏振旋轉效率。
workedExample.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input, 0.800 mW desired-port and 0.008 mW leakage power give 20 dB port extinction. Total transmission 0.808 implies 0.926 dB loss. Extinction and total transmission differ; rotation efficiency is not separately determined.
workedExample.assumptions: 端口功率、偏振純度與高階模態含量必須分別定義；僅測總功率不能證明 TE/TM 旋轉。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Define port power, polarization purity and higher-order modal content separately; total power alone cannot prove TE/TM rotation.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Multimode self-imaging, split balance and complex S-parameters, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想 1 mW 輸入，兩輸出為 0.46、0.44 mW，總傳輸 0.90，過量損耗 −10log10(0.90)=0.458 dB；不平衡 10log10(0.46/0.44)=0.193 dB。理想均分每路 3.010 dB 是功率分配，不是 3.010 dB 的過量損耗。
workedExample.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input and 0.46/0.44 mW outputs, total transmission is 0.90, excess loss 0.458 dB and imbalance 0.193 dB. The ideal 3.010 dB per branch is power division, not excess loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 自成像近似只提供初估，需以足夠模態、正確端口和波長掃描驗證；數值收斂與實物校準是不同工作。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Self-imaging approximations give initial estimates; verify sufficient modes, correct ports and wavelength sweeps. Numerical convergence differs from physical calibration.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

courses.title: 方向耦合器製作
courses.summary: 以倏逝耦合、超模拍頻與製程容差為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Evanescent coupling, supermode beating and fabrication tolerance, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設無損對稱雙波導的超模傳播常數差 Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹，κ=Δβ/2=0.02 μm⁻¹。交叉功率 sin²(κL)，第一次全轉移長度 π/Δβ=78.54 μm，第一次均分長度 π/(2Δβ)=39.27 μm；完整拍長 2π/Δβ=157.08 μm。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical lossless symmetric guides, supermode difference Δβ=0.04 μm⁻¹ gives κ=0.02 μm⁻¹. Cross power is sin²(κL); first full transfer is at 78.54 μm, first equal split at 39.27 μm, and full beat length is 157.08 μm.
workedExample.assumptions: 簡式假設相同單模波導、固定耦合係數與無損；彎曲入口、非對稱、色散及輻射需另建模。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The reduced equation assumes identical single-mode guides, constant coupling and no loss; bends, asymmetry, dispersion and radiation need separate treatment.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

courses.title: 馬赫曾德爾調變器
courses.summary: 以MZI 相位—強度轉換、偏壓與行波電極為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address MZI phase-to-intensity conversion, bias and traveling-wave electrodes, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設無損平衡 MZI 的單臂 Δn_eff=10⁻⁴、L=1 mm、λ=1550 nm，Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=0.4054 rad。由亮態偏移時正規化輸出 cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595；單臂 π 相移需 Δn_eff=λ/(2L)=7.75×10⁻⁴。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical balanced lossless MZI, one-arm Δn_eff=10⁻⁴, L=1 mm and λ=1550 nm give Δφ=0.4054 rad. Moving from the bright state gives normalized output cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595; a one-arm π shift needs Δn_eff=7.75×10⁻⁴.
workedExample.assumptions: 此算例不含兩臂損耗、分光失衡、電極傳輸或載子吸收；亮態附近響應不等於正交偏壓的小訊號響應。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The example omits arm loss, splitter imbalance, electrode propagation and carrier absorption; bright-state response differs from small-signal response at quadrature.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

knowledge.textEn: At fixed bias compare eyes at two data rates and drive swings. Do not infer: Maximum extinction always gives minimum error rate

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設無損平衡 MZI 的單臂 Δn_eff=10⁻⁴、L=1 mm、λ=1550 nm，Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=0.4054 rad。由亮態偏移時正規化輸出 cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595；單臂 π 相移需 Δn_eff=λ/(2L)=7.75×10⁻⁴。 此算例不含兩臂損耗、分光失衡、電極傳輸或載子吸收；亮態附近響應不等於正交偏壓的小訊號響應。
knowledge.textEn: For a hypothetical balanced lossless MZI, one-arm Δn_eff=10⁻⁴, L=1 mm and λ=1550 nm give Δφ=0.4054 rad. Moving from the bright state gives normalized output cos²(Δφ/2)=0.9595; a one-arm π shift needs Δn_eff=7.75×10⁻⁴. The example omits arm loss, splitter imbalance, electrode propagation and carrier absorption; bright-state response differs from small-signal response at quadrature.

quiz.question: 就「評估資料眼圖」而言，哪項原理正確？
quiz.questionEn: For assess data eyes, which principle is correct?
options: 靜態消光和小訊號頻寬都不足以單獨預測含驅動失真與噪聲的資料眼。
最大消光比必然給最低資料錯誤率
吻合一個偏壓即可證明全範圍模型
optionsEn: Static extinction and small-signal bandwidth alone do not determine a data eye with driver distortion and noise.
Maximum extinction always gives minimum error rate
Matching one bias validates the entire range
quiz.explanation: 靜態消光和小訊號頻寬都不足以單獨預測含驅動失真與噪聲的資料眼。 此算例不含兩臂損耗、分光失衡、電極傳輸或載子吸收；亮態附近響應不等於正交偏壓的小訊號響應。
quiz.explanationEn: Static extinction and small-signal bandwidth alone do not determine a data eye with driver distortion and noise. The example omits arm loss, splitter imbalance, electrode propagation and carrier absorption; bright-state response differs from small-signal response at quadrature.

steps.title: 評估資料眼圖：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Assess data eyes: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 用評估資料眼圖的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
steps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of assess data eyes to distinguish competing explanations.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，執行下列資料判讀：固定偏壓比較兩種資料速率與輸入擺幅的眼圖。 將原始量、單位、量測參考面與重複性分欄記錄；比較預測與觀察，說明能排除「最大消光比必然給最低資料錯誤率」的直接證據，再決定接受、重測或修模。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and perform this data review: At fixed bias compare eyes at two data rates and drive swings. Record raw values, units, reference planes and repeatability separately. Compare prediction with observation and identify direct evidence rejecting "Maximum extinction always gives minimum error rate" before accepting, remeasuring or revising.
steps.observation: 固定偏壓比較兩種資料速率與輸入擺幅的眼圖。
steps.observationEn: At fixed bias compare eyes at two data rates and drive swings.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「最大消光比必然給最低資料錯誤率」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Maximum extinction always gives minimum error rate" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交評估資料眼圖的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：固定偏壓比較兩種資料速率與輸入擺幅的眼圖。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for assess data eyes: At fixed bias compare eyes at two data rates and drive swings. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

courses.title: 微環調變器
courses.summary: 以微環共振、耦合條件、線寬與調變漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ring resonance, coupling conditions, linewidth and modulation drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 r=10 μm、n_g=4、λ=1550 nm，周長 62.832 μm，局部 FSR≈λ²/(n_g·2πr)=9.559 nm。載入 Q=10000 對應線寬 λ/Q=0.155 nm；假想漂移係數 80 pm/K、升溫 2 K 造成 0.160 nm 位移，約一個線寬。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical r=10 μm, n_g=4 and λ=1550 nm, circumference is 62.832 μm and local FSR≈9.559 nm. Loaded Q=10000 gives 0.155 nm linewidth. An assumed 80 pm/K drift over 2 K shifts resonance 0.160 nm, about one linewidth.
workedExample.assumptions: FSR 用群折射率，Q 為載入值；局部波長近似不涵蓋跨大頻帶色散。漂移係數自行設定，不是所有矽微環的材料常數。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: FSR uses group index and Q is loaded; the local wavelength approximation omits broad-band dispersion. The chosen drift coefficient is not universal for silicon rings.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

courses.title: 鍺光偵測器整合
courses.summary: 以Ge 吸收、載子收集與光電量測基準為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ge absorption, carrier collection and optoelectronic reference planes, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。

steps.objective: 建立確認線性與飽和的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for confirm linearity and saturation.
steps.instruction: 先標出「確認線性與飽和」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。高光功率的空間電荷、電路限流或自熱可壓縮響應，暗扣除不足以修正。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for confirm linearity and saturation. Space charge, circuit current limits or heating can compress high-power response; dark subtraction cannot fix it. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 掃輸入功率並看增量斜率，而非只看總電流。
steps.observationEn: Sweep optical input and inspect incremental slope, not only total current.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「扣除暗電流後響應必定線性」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Dark subtraction guarantees linear response" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交確認線性與飽和的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：掃輸入功率並看增量斜率，而非只看總電流。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for confirm linearity and saturation: Sweep optical input and inspect incremental slope, not only total current. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.textEn: Sweep optical input and inspect incremental slope, not only total current. Do not infer: Dark subtraction guarantees linear response

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction. External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.

Dark subtraction guarantees linear response
Reducing capacitance allows unlimited bandwidth

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction. External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.

courses.summary: 以Ge 吸收／Si 乘增分工、增益與過量噪聲為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ge absorption/Si multiplication, gain and excess noise, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想單位增益光電流 I₀=5 μA、M=10，平均乘增光電流 50 μA。電子注入局部模型取 k=β/α=0.10（電洞／電子游離係數比），F=kM+(1−k)(2−1/M)=2.71；初級光電流散粒噪聲的單邊功率譜密度為 2qI₀M²F，不是只乘 M。
workedExample.textEn: For hypothetical unity-gain photocurrent I₀=5 μA and M=10, mean multiplied current is 50 μA. An electron-injection local model with k=β/α=0.10 (hole/electron ionization ratio) gives F=kM+(1−k)(2−1/M)=2.71. Primary photocurrent shot-noise one-sided PSD is 2qI₀M²F, not merely multiplied by M.
workedExample.assumptions: 此例採線性模式、均勻局部游離與電子注入近似；薄乘增層的非局部效應、混合注入、暗電流和電路噪聲另算。提高平均增益不能單獨證明 SNR 改善。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: This assumes linear mode, uniform local ionization and electron injection. Nonlocal effects in thin multiplication regions, mixed injection, dark current and circuit noise are separate. Mean gain alone does not establish improved SNR.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設均勻有效熱光係數 dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、L=1 mm、λ=1.55 μm，ΔTπ=λ/(2L·dn_eff/dT)=4.306 K。若集總 R_th=200 K/W，Pπ=21.53 mW；再假設 C_th=10 μJ/K，τ=R_thC_th=2.00 ms。
workedExample.textEn: With hypothetical uniform effective dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, L=1 mm and λ=1.55 μm, ΔTπ=4.306 K. A lumped R_th=200 K/W gives Pπ=21.53 mW; assumed C_th=10 μJ/K gives τ=2.00 ms.
workedExample.assumptions: 係數是有效模態係數而非純材料值，溫度視為均勻；R_th、C_th 為同一集總熱節點，真實結構可能有多個時間常數及溫度相依電阻。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: The coefficient is modal rather than purely material and temperature is uniform. R_th/C_th describe one lumped thermal node; real structures can have multiple time constants and temperature-dependent resistance.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，執行下列資料判讀：以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。 將原始量、單位、量測參考面與重複性分欄記錄；比較預測與觀察，說明能排除「知道 Pπ 即可完成所有控制設計」的直接證據，再決定接受、重測或修模。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and perform this data review: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target. knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 控制器需要功率—相位曲線、動態、串擾與工作範圍，而非只有 Pπ。
knowledge.textEn: A controller needs power-phase curves, dynamics, crosstalk and bounds, not only Pπ.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。 不可推成：知道 Pπ 即可完成所有控制設計
knowledge.textEn: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target. Do not infer: Pπ alone completes control design

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設均勻有效熱光係數 dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、L=1 mm、λ=1.55 μm，ΔTπ=λ/(2L·dn_eff/dT)=4.306 K。若集總 R_th=200 K/W，Pπ=21.53 mW；再假設 C_th=10 μJ/K，τ=R_thC_th=2.00 ms。 係數是有效模態係數而非純材料值，溫度視為均勻；R_th、C_th 為同一集總熱節點，真實結構可能有多個時間常數及溫度相依電阻。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical uniform effective dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, L=1 mm and λ=1.55 μm, ΔTπ=4.306 K. A lumped R_th=200 K/W gives Pπ=21.53 mW; assumed C_th=10 μJ/K gives τ=2.00 ms. The coefficient is modal rather than purely material and temperature is uniform. R_th/C_th describe one lumped thermal node; real structures can have multiple time constants and temperature-dependent resistance.

courses.title: 載子耗盡相位調變
courses.summary: 以反向接面耗盡、複數折射率與電光限制為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Reverse-junction depletion, complex index and electro-optic limits, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
courses.scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
courses.scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設已知有效折射率改變 Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴、L=2 mm、λ=1550 nm，單一路徑 Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=−1.621 rad。另取集總 R=50 Ω、C=100 fF，f_RC=1/(2πRC)=31.83 GHz；這個電氣單極估計不是整體電光頻寬。
workedExample.textEn: With hypothetical known Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴, L=2 mm and λ=1550 nm, single-path Δφ=−1.621 rad. Separately, lumped R=50 Ω and C=100 fF give f_RC=31.83 GHz; this electrical single-pole estimate is not total electro-optic bandwidth.
workedExample.assumptions: Δn_eff 是自行指定的有號模態差，未由某劑量或偏壓保證；載子濃度、重疊、吸收、電容與 RF 傳輸必須以同一截面及偏壓驗證。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Δn_eff is an independently chosen signed modal difference, not guaranteed by a dose or bias. Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.
workedExample.sourceScope: 本算例數值自行設定；來源支援原理，不提供這組產品規格。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Example values are independently chosen; sources support principles, not these product specifications.

steps.title: 定義接面與反向偏壓：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define junction and reverse bias: model and design

knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical known Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴, L=2 mm and λ=1550 nm, single-path Δφ=−1.621 rad. Separately, lumped R=50 Ω and C=100 fF give f_RC=31.83 GHz; this electrical single-pole estimate is not total electro-optic bandwidth. Δn_eff is an independently chosen signed modal difference, not guaranteed by a dose or bias. Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.

Extract complex modal index and propagation loss at each bias.
Carrier changes affect phase but never loss

steps.instruction: 先標出「比較接面配置」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。橫向、垂直或交錯接面改變場重疊、電容與電阻，不能只以一個 VπL 排名。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for compare junction placement. Lateral, vertical or interleaved junctions alter overlap, capacitance and resistance; VπL alone cannot rank them. steps.observation: 比較相同長度下的相移、損耗與 C–V。
